purpose: Canonical cross-domain coupling seeds for the Atlas. These are structural relationships, not claims of hidden coordination.

couplings.why: Connect national records to constitutional and administrative institutions.
Connect public agencies to legal authority and oversight.
Make legal mandates and oversight discoverable.
Connect economic actors to jurisdictions without implying ownership.
Expose documented financial relationships when sourced.
Connect firms to physical systems and supply chains.
Model generation, transmission and security as one system.
Show industrial dependence on electricity infrastructure.
Connect physical logistics to international flows.
Connect trade corridors to productive sectors.
Connect beliefs to geography while avoiding assumptions about individual adherence.
Connect traditions to documented institutions and organizations.
Connect historical events to institutional change.
Every empirical claim should be traceable to evidence.
Prevent isolated backend datasets and expose the wider graph.

guardrails: Do not infer covert relationships from shared geography or sector
Do not infer ownership from business presence
Do not infer ideological affiliation from association alone
Do not infer individual religious adherence from country-level presence
Every empirical edge should carry provenance when available
